concept_attempts.feedback: Selected: broad mineral body, compact asymmetric crown with left point/right lobe, two lower-left blue insets and two opposing lower-right brass bent fittings. Fine sections/joints and hidden faces are authored; no Terran shipyard equipment added.

issues: Foundation, two blue insets and two opposing brass fittings follow the source layout.
The rounded joined crown looks like separate soft balls. Replace with one irregular angular mineral mass, retaining the short left point and blunt right lobe.
Angular crown avoids the previous soft separated-ball appearance.
Left crown feature became a broad triangular roof. Original shows a shorter narrow protrusion above a compact blunt mass; reduce crown height and author a narrow seated left point.

final_review: Final independent GLB retains the broad mineral foundation, compact angular crown with short left point/right lobe, two lower-left blue insets and two lower-right opposing brass fittings. Actual feedback replaces soft separated crown balls and then a too-broad triangular roof with a compact seated mineral mass and narrower left point. Brass elements are seated on the actual body.
limitations: Exact sections, brass engineering, hidden surfaces and material wear are authored from limited original views.
Automated ship construction is original lore, but no specific crane, platform, robot or operating cycle is visible and none is invented.
